# RTX 4090 Validation Index

Generated: 2026-05-12T00:05:07.0569913Z

| Item | Status | Exit | Evidence | Command |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| 00 baseline | captured | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/00-env/baseline-summary.json` | `git/nvidia-smi/nvcc/Get-ComputerInfo capture` |
| harness-check | passed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/01-harness/harness-check-summary.json` | `.\tools\harness-check.ps1` |
| local-rc-closeout | passed | 0 | `console: final local-rc-closeout rerun passed` | `.\tools\local-rc-closeout.ps1 -RunLocalBaseline -RunCpuTrainingSmoke -BuildDir build-vscode` |
| acceptance local package | passed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/acceptance-local-package/acceptance_summary.json` | `.\tools\acceptance-smoke.ps1 -LocalBaseline -Package -SkipBuild` |
| cpu training smoke | passed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/cpu-training-smoke/acceptance_summary.json` | `.\tools\acceptance-smoke.ps1 -CpuTrainingSmoke -SkipOfficialOcr` |
| TensorRT acceptance | passed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/acceptance-tensorrt/acceptance_summary.json` | `.\tools\acceptance-smoke.ps1 -TensorRT -BuildDir build-vscode` |
| Phase45 YOLO matrix | passed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/phase45-yolo-matrix/yolo_model_matrix_summary.json` | `.\tools\phase45-yolo-model-matrix-smoke.ps1 -IncludeYolo12` |
| Phase47 PaddleOCR Det ONNX | passed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/phase47-paddleocr-det-onnx/paddleocr_det_onnx_smoke_summary.json` | `Paddle 2.6 old-IR export + paddle2onnx + aitrain_worker --ocr-det-onnx-smoke` |
| Production OCR data | prepared | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-data/manifests/production_ocr_data_manifest.json` | `.\tools\prepare-production-ocr-data.ps1` |
| Production OCR official chain | evidence-collected | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-official-chain/reports` | `official Det/Rec/System adapters` |
| Production OCR acceptance | blocked | 1 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-acceptance/production_ocr_acceptance_report.json` | `.\tools\production-ocr-acceptance.ps1 -RequireDetOnnxEvidence` |
| Production OCR Rec GPU experiment | completed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-rec-experiments/gpu-pretrained-en-epoch20-eval75/rec_experiment_summary.json` | `.\tools\run-production-ocr-rec-experiment.ps1 -UseGpu -UsePretrained -Epochs 20 -TrainLimit 0 -ValLimit 0` |
| Production OCR GPU official chain gate rerun | passed | 0 | `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-acceptance-gpu-chain/production_ocr_acceptance_report.json` | `.\tools\production-ocr-acceptance.ps1` with GPU Det/Rec/System reports + Phase47 evidence |

## Current Interpretation

- All non-accuracy verification items are evidence-backed on RTX 4090 D: baseline, harness build/CTest, RC closeout, package acceptance, CPU training smoke, TensorRT, Phase45 YOLO matrix, and Phase47 PaddleOCR Det ONNX.
- Phase47 Det ONNX is `passed`: old-IR Paddle 2.6 export was converted to ONNX and consumed by the C++ Worker smoke at `.deps/rtx4090-validation/phase47-paddleocr-det-onnx/cpp_onnx_smoke/ocr_det_onnx_predictions.json`.
- The historical Production OCR acceptance report remains `blocked`: it referenced the old CPU/default Rec report with accuracy `0` and CER `0.925639` in `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-acceptance/production_ocr_acceptance_report.json`.
- A fresh gate rerun using the RTX 4090 GPU official Det/Rec/System reports is `passed` under the current `accuracy > 0.7` Rec gate: `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-acceptance-gpu-chain/production_ocr_acceptance_report.json` records accuracy `0.71874997504340365` and CER `0.14153062880387579`; CER is recorded but not blocking by default.
- Per current user direction, the Production OCR Rec gate was lowered to strict `accuracy > 0.7`; the previous `accuracy >= 0.90` / `CER <= 0.10` quality target is no longer the default blocking gate.
- GPU Paddle environment is now available at `.deps/rtx4090-validation/python-ocr-gpu`; `paddlepaddle-gpu==3.3.1` reports CUDA ready on RTX 4090 D.
- The GPU Rec experiment completed with real official-tool evidence: accuracy `0.71527775294174478`, CER `0.1409009440814718`, train/export/predict exit code 0, report at `E:\code\AITrain\.deps\rtx4090-validation\production-ocr-rec-experiments\gpu-pretrained-en-epoch20-eval75\official_rec\paddleocr_official_rec_report.json`.

## Remaining Risk

- Production OCR Rec still needs a stronger dataset/model/training strategy if the stricter `accuracy >= 0.90` and `CER <= 0.10` target is reinstated later; current acceptance uses `accuracy > 0.7`.
- A longer `gpu-pretrained-en-epoch80-eval150` experiment was intentionally interrupted after the user said not to consider accuracy; partial artifacts may exist under `.deps/rtx4090-validation/production-ocr-rec-experiments/gpu-pretrained-en-epoch80-eval150`.

## Passed Evidence

- RTX 4090 D baseline, harness build/CTest, local RC closeout, local package acceptance, CPU training smoke, TensorRT acceptance, Phase45 YOLO11/YOLO12 detection/segmentation matrix, and Phase47 PaddleOCR Det ONNX all have passing evidence.
- All generated dependencies, datasets, weights, ONNX/engine files, logs, and reports are under `.deps/rtx4090-validation` and remain untracked by design.
